walkthroughs.body_html:
Makoko sits on Lagos Lagoon with around 250,000 people in stilt houses.

Problems include:
• No running water or sewage
• Cholera outbreaks
• Threat of demolition (2012 evictions)

Yet residents earn from fishing and timber trading.

Lagos State government schemes:

• Lagos BRT (Bus Rapid Transit) — launched 2008
• Eko Atlantic — luxury city on reclaimed land
• New light rail (Blue Line opened 2023)

Critics say they help the rich more than the poor.

Communities and NGOs help via:

• Self-help housing upgrades
• Site and service schemes (land + water)
• Floating schools (Makoko Floating School)

These are cheaper and community-led.
